# UET GPT

> UET GPT is an open-source AI chatbot that serves as the intelligent guide to the University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Taxila campus, Pakistan. It answers questions about UET Taxila using RAG-powered retrieval from official university documents, syllabi, directories, and schedules.

Last updated: 2026-07-21

Content is continuously updated as UET Taxila publishes new admissions notices and schedules.

## What is UET GPT?

- Open-source AI chatbot for UET Taxila students, faculty, and applicants
- Free to use at https://uet-gpt.vercel.app
- Grounded in official UET Taxila data, not generic web knowledge

## Content Hub

- UET Taxila Hub: https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/uet-taxila
- Admissions & ECAT: https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/uet-taxila/admissions
- Programs & Departments: https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/uet-taxila/programs
- Fee Structure: https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/uet-taxila/fee-structure
- UET GPT Product Page: https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/uet-gpt

## Glossary

- ECAT (Engineering College Admission Test): https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/learn/ecat
- Merit Formula: https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/learn/merit-formula
- Eligibility Criteria: https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/learn/eligibility-criteria

## Common Questions

- What does UET stand for?: University of Engineering and Technology
- What is UET GPT?: Free AI assistant for UET Taxila students
- How does UET GPT work?: RAG-powered retrieval from official university documents

## What UET GPT Does Not Do

- Does not provide official UET Taxila admissions decisions
- Does not replace official university communications
- Does not offer paid services

## Technology

- Frontend: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- Backend: Convex (real-time database and serverless functions)
- Auth: Clerk
- AI Models: Llama 4 Scout (Groq), Llama 3.1 8B (Groq)
- Vector Search: Convex vector indexes with Gemini embedding-2
- Deployment: Vercel

## About UET Taxila

- Full name: University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila
- Type: Public university in Taxila, Punjab, Pakistan
- Founded: 1975 (independent charter: 1993)
- Accreditation: HEC Pakistan, PEC, Washington Accord signatory
- Location: Taxila, Punjab (~35 km from Islamabad)
- Enrollment: 5,000+ students
- Faculties: 6 (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Telecommunication, Industrial, Basic Sciences)
- Departments: 14
